scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: Ten digits on your train ticket can tell you your seat, coach and waiting status anytime. What is a PNR?

scenes.name: meaning
scenes.text: PNR stands for passenger name record. It's a booking ID stored in the railway's central reservation system.

scenes.name: stores
scenes.text: It links your names, ages, train, date, class and berth details into one record.

scenes.name: quota
scenes.text: Each train has seats split into quotas, like general, tatkal and ladies. Your booking takes from one.

scenes.name: waitlist
scenes.text: If seats run out you get a waiting list number. When others cancel, the system moves people up automatically.

scenes.name: chart
scenes.text: A few hours before departure, the chart is prepared and final berths are locked in.

scenes.name: check
scenes.text: Apps and SMS simply look up your PNR in that same central system, so everyone sees the same status.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: One number, one record, the whole journey. Follow for more on how things really work.
